text.h01: [excited] You're late! [laughs] …Kidding, kidding, I just got here too! [playful] Hehe, it's my day off, so I came in disguise.
text.h02: [playful] Can you tell it's me? Isn't this cap cute?
text.h03a: [excited] Right, right?! Okay, I'm winning everything today!
text.h03b: [surprised] What, no way! [softly] …Well, fine, as long as it's only you. [excited] Okay, let's go!
text.h04: [excited] Taiko first! Loser buys drinks! [shouting] …Ready, go!
text.h05w: [shouting] No way!? I lost…! One more! …Is what I want to say, but a deal's a deal. [sighs] Drinks on me.
text.h05l: [excited] Yay! I win! [laughs] Hehe, drinks are on you!
text.h06: [excited] Next, racing! Sit next to me! [playful] …This one blows wind at you.
text.h07a: [shouting] Whoa, fast! No way, you passed me!
text.h07b: [annoyed] Hey! No ramming! …Unfair! [laughs] I'm getting you back!
text.h08: [breathless] Haa, haa… that was too fun. [softly] …Why is it fun even when I lose, with you?
text.h09: [excited] Oh, look! I want that cat plushie…! [shy] …Will you get it for me?
text.h10x: [disappointed] Ah, so close! The claw's too weak! [excited] …One more!
text.h10: [excited] Got it! Amazing! [softly] …Thank you. [shy] …I'll treasure this one.
text.h13b: [flustered] …!? Wh-what are you writing…! [shy] …Then I'm writing the same thing.
text.h14: [shivering] Brr! [playful] …Here, corn soup. Instead of that drink. …Boop.
text.h15: [whispers] …Hey. I'm never showing today's purikura on stream. …It's a secret, just yours and mine.
text.h16a: [excited] Yeah! Next time I'm totally not losing!
text.h16b: [flustered] Huh…!? Th-that'd… give it away to everyone…! [shy] …But I'm kind of happy.
